subject: Request: Priority availability window & temporary SLA uplift for Falkon demo week
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@falkon.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Priority availability window & temporary SLA uplift for Falkon demo week

Team —

Falkon (Elena copied) just confirmed a public demo week the week of Feb 8 where they expect a concentrated traffic spike across our hosted API. They are asking for a temporary, higher-availability commitment for their peak windows to ensure the demo runs smoothly. High-level asks from the customer:

- A short-term availability uplift for the demo week (Feb 8–12) for their EU+US traffic window (target: 99.995% availability during 08:00–20:00 PT each day).
- Priority routing to dedicated burst pool for Falkon requests during peak hours.
- Operational runbook and an on-call overlap for the demo window.

I attached the initial ask packet they sent (Falkon_Demand_Growth_SLA_asks.pdf). Can engineering confirm whether we can safely offer a timeboxed elevated commitment and what the hard engineering blockers are? Stephanie — can you outline required infra changes, capacity reservations, and risk mitigation steps? Connor/Marissa — we’ll need to scope commercial terms (pilot length, credits, pricing uplift) and legal redline.

Proposed next step: quick alignment call tomorrow 9:30am PT to triage. If we can say yes there are clear operational steps and costs, we can move to a sales/legal sprint with Falkon.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Falkon_Demand_Growth_SLA_asks.pdf (PDF, 210KB)]

Ben —

Thanks for looping us in. Confirming Falkon is prepared to:

- Provide realistic traffic estimates (attached) and a short SOW for the pilot week.
- Offer a trade: additional 3 months of usage commit if Redwood can provide the temporary priority window and documented runbook.
- Accept an elevated rate for reserved burst capacity (open to negotiation) — we prefer a transparent uplift rather than opaque credits.

Attached: traffic_estimates.csv (sample RPS profile for Feb 8–12). Legal is on standby if we can share a draft amendment.

—Elena
Elena Ruiz

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena@falkon.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Priority availability window & temporary SLA uplift for Falkon demo week

Quick technical readout after reviewing the attachment and Falkon's traffic profile:

What we can offer (short window, timeboxed):
- Dedicated burst pool with reserved GPU slots for 08:00–20:00 PT each demo day. This isolates their traffic and reduces noisy-neighbor risk.
- Prefix caching warm-up and pre-warmed KV caches for known workloads.
- Priority routing by customer token to the reserved pool; fallback to best-effort pool only if reserved pool is exhausted (we should document fallback semantics clearly).

Hard constraints / open questions:
1) Autoscale latency: our current autoscaler has a 3–5 minute spin-up at cold start on certain instance types; to meet the commitment we must pre-reserve capacity rather than rely on autoscale during the peak.
2) Regional routing: Falkon wants EU+US guaranteed coverage. We'll need reservations in both us-west and eu-west zones and an operational runbook for cross-region failover.
3) Observability: we need per-token SLO dashboards and an SLA telemetry tag so CS/eng can validate uptime during the window.

Operational asks from eng (minimal list):
- 8 dedicated GPU slots in us-west and 6 in eu-west for Feb 8–12 (suggest N+2 buffer).
- A temporary routing policy config (token->burst-pool) and a rollback policy.
- An ops runbook covering incident escalation and cache-warm strategies.

I attached a skeleton ops runbook (ops_runbook_draft.md). If legal needs wording for the amendment we can propose exactly what the failure metrics and remediation credits are.

Stephanie Nguyen
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
[Attachment: ops_runbook_draft.md (MD, 12KB)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Priority availability window & temporary SLA uplift for Falkon demo week

Thanks Stephanie — that matches my read. Commercial and legal gating items to close before we commit:

- Exec sign-off on one-time infra reservation costs (estimate from infra ops).
- Legal needs a short amendment (timeboxed) with explicit remediation terms (credits or free days) and a definition of the measurement window.
- Finance/RevOps will require a pricing uplift addendum or pilot discount defined in a SOW.

Marissa — can you draft a short commercial proposal: pilot length (we recommend 1 week with a 3-month usage commitment if uplift accepted), proposed uplift percentage, and credit structure for SLA misses? I can loop in legal once we have a proposed draft.

Connor O'Brien
Customer Success — Strategic Accounts

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 15:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Priority availability window & temporary SLA uplift for Falkon demo week

Ben/Connor/Stephanie —

Draft commercial approach below (for discussion):

- Pilot structure: 1-week priority window (Feb 8–12) + 3-month minimum usage commitment if Falkon accepts uplift.
- Pricing: 15% uplift on standard reserved burst rate for the pilot week, billed as part of a short-term amendment. If the customer commits to the 3-month usage increase, we apply a 7% credit back over months 2–3.
- Credits for SLA misses: linear credits up to 50% of the uplifted fee for repeated breaches during the pilot window; single brief breaches will trigger a 10% credit.
- Next steps: get engineering to confirm exact slot counts and a one-line cost estimate (infra ops), legal to prepare timeboxed amendment, and leadership to approve the commercial uplift.

If leadership wants to avoid cash uplift during a pilot, we can propose extra committed usage instead (Elena indicated Falkon is open). Will prepare a 1-page commercial memo for exec review.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Lead

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@falkon.ai>, legal@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Priority availability window & temporary SLA uplift for Falkon demo week

Thanks all — good progress. Quick summary and asks before I take to execs: 

- Engineering: confirm final slot counts and rough one-time infra reservation cost by EOD Thursday (ops estimate needed for budgeting).
- Legal: draft a short, timeboxed amendment using the runbook and credit structure Marissa outlined.
- Sales/CS: finalize the commercial memo (Marissa) and the draft SOW.

Elena — appreciate Falkon's flexibility on either uplift or committed usage. If we can get the engineering and legal artifacts by Thursday we can present to leadership on Friday morning for a rapid yes/no.
